title: Couple at Jamestown 350th Anniversary Sign, 1957 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white deckle-edged snapshot depicting an elderly couple posing beside a prominent commemorative sign on a brick wall during the 1957 Jamestown Festival in Virginia. The plaque marks the 350th anniversary (1607–1957) of the founding of Jamestown, recognizing it as the beginning of the overseas expansion of English-speaking peoples, the Commonwealth of Virginia, the United States, and the British Commonwealth of Nations. The 1957 event was a major national celebration visited by Queen Elizabeth II and President Dwight D. Eisenhower.
